meaning_fixes.reason: Source '己の力で戦い抜け' means 'fight it through using your own strength/power', an encouragement to self-reliance addressed to a struggling ally (part of the 13677-13681 encouragement sequence: 'There's still work to do', 'Surely there's more', ..., 'Believe in your own power', 'Surely that's not it'). 'Fight alone' invents an isolation/no-backup implication ('己の力で' means 'with your own power', not 'without company') that the source does not state and that contradicts the encouraging tone of the surrounding lines.

Tone contradicting the run of praise it belongs to: 'さすがだ' is a compliment ('impressive/as expected of you'), sitting among 13682-13686 ('Your skill, noted.', 'Not bad, are you.', 'You fight well.', ..., 'Superb skill.'). 'Indeed' reads as a neutral agreement rather than praise, breaking the praise register of the sequence; 'Skilled.' restores it within the same 8-character budget.
Shout rows must not contain a newline (source line breaks are joined); joined into one line, and the trailing period dropped to fit the 34-char budget exactly (35 chars would have been 1 over).

checked_decisions.finding: Compressed 'My style can't win...!' and 'My mistake?' for Tsukiomi/Hokushin's named-technique and self-doubt lines keep the core meaning; dropped technique names are a glossary/terminology matter, not a meaning reversal.
Plural/unnamed addressee kept correctly ("your fates end", "Show me all your power", "Interfere, and you too...") without inventing an identity or gender for the enemy party.
Source '殺せ' has no trailing closing punctuation; target 'Any means will do - kill' correctly matches by omitting a trailing period, consistent with the source's own abrupt cutoff.

uncertainties.issue: Ruling: dropping the researched 'Mokuren-shiki Juu' style name for budget reasons is a terminology matter, not a meaning error; 'My style can't win...!' correctly keeps the self-doubt.

Ruling: 'My mistake?' is an acceptable compression of 'did I underestimate the enemy'; reused verbatim at dialogue_13719 for the same speaker's parallel line, which is fine since both source lines carry the same self-doubt.
Ruling: plural 'your fates end' correctly keeps the addressee vague/plural since the enemy party is not named in this line.

Ruling: 'You overrate yourselves' for '自らの力を計り違える者どもよ' avoids the lowercase j while keeping the taunt and the plural (-domo) addressee; sound choice. Also fixed for the no-newline rule (see meaning_fixes).

Ruling: the couplet is genuinely archaic/obscure; the compressed rendering approximates the imagery without inventing unrelated content. Left as the translator's flagged best-effort, in addition to the no-newline fix above.
Ruling: plural 'your power' correctly reflects '貴様らの力' (-ra plural marker).
Ruling: contemptuous 'you' kept gender-neutral for an unnamed target; correct per BASE_RULES.
